department: Gustaf H. Carlson School of Chemistry and Biochemistry

deadline.value: Fall 2027 deadline for Chemistry Ph.D. is January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: All other Ph.D. programs | Friday, January 15, 2027

gre_general.value: GRE scores are preferred for holistic review, though they may be waived for applicants with a thesis-based master's degree, peer-reviewed publications, strong ACS-certified major GPA/research, or industrial experience.
gre_general.quote: We prefer for all applicants to include GRE scores in their application package as these are a helpful component of our holistic assessment process. In some cases, however, GRE scores may be waived if the other components of the application create a strong case for admission on their own.

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Subject Test (ETS now offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Prospective students are encouraged to connect with the department before applying to ensure a match with a faculty research group.
supervisor.quote: Having the right combination of academic skills and research interests to match our program and a particular faculty’s research group is, therefore, a key aspect of becoming a successful chemistry graduate student at Clark. We encourage prospective students to connect with us prior to submitting an application to ensure that our program is the right match for you.

funding.value: Graduate students in good standing receive full tuition remission for five years, a 9-month teaching assistantship stipend, summer research support, and conference travel funding.
funding.quote: Graduate students receive full tuition remission for five years and serve as teaching assistants for a minimum of two semesters. Students receive a 9-month stipend plus tuition remission and summer research support while at Clark and in good standing.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree completion is the baseline requirement prior to graduate enrollment (with GRE waivers also recognizing an ACS-certified chemistry major or a thesis-based master's degree).
entry_route.quote: Official final bachelor’s degree transcripts, including confirmation of earned degree, are required prior to enrollment.

notes: Support beyond the fifth year may be requested. Research assistantships are available as funding allows.
